title: Director or Sr. Director, Origination
description:
ABOUT AVANTUS

Avantus develops, owns and operates utility-scale clean energy projects across California and the Desert Southwest. Our development pipeline of solar with integrated storage will generate enough dispatchable power to serve more than 10 million Americans, day and night. Backed by strategic investment from KKR and EIG, and building on more than a decade of industry leadership, Avantus is growing its position as an independent power producer, delivering affordable, reliable clean energy solutions to meet America’s growing energy demand.

ABOUT THE POSITION:

We are seeking a highly motivated and organized candidate for the Director or Sr. Director, Origination position. The successful candidate will demonstrate sound industry knowledge, superior communications, and detail-oriented organizational skills.

The Director or Sr. Director, Origination will join a growing Origination team with the main objective of sourcing, negotiating, and executing PPA’s and other complex power off-take arrangements. The role requires advanced knowledge of CAISO and Southwest power markets, as well as extensive experience with contracting and PPA structures and negotiation related to US utility-scale solar and energy storage. This role reports to the Executive Vice President, Origination and Energy Markets.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for Business Development – originate new opportunities for solar and energy storage off-take in defined territory.
  • Create new and build upon existing key relationships with utilities, CCA’s and off-take partners
  • Negotiate and close PPA’s with large utility and other target customers - manage contract transaction execution including due diligence, negotiation, and post-closing oversight
  • Respond to Requests for Proposals (RFPs)
  • Work with the finance team to perform financial analyses, support the creation of new analytical models
  • Work in close collaboration with the Finance and Project Development functional teams
  • Working on multiple projects and transactions at any given time with multiple teams
  • Assess and translate market competition, industry trends, emerging customer challenges and changes into market strategies.
  • Understand legal, regulatory and structuring concepts impacting customer and market development.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5-10 years related experience in power origination roles preferably solar with strong track record of closing PPA’s.
  • Bachelor's and master’s degree in Business Administration
  • Strong experience with utility-scale energy procurement structures and transactions
  • Energy markets knowledge with focus on solar energy - regulatory policies, rates and tariffs, electric transmission, solar generation and storage technologies
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% in defined territory
  • Excellent interpersonal skills; written and verbal.
  • Ability to work independently and as a team member.
  • Excellent sales, networking, leadership, negotiation and time management skills

ABOUT THE POSITION

The Engineer or Senior Engineer, Development Engineering is responsible for developing the site constraints for early to late-stage development projects. They will act as the technical lead for engineering studies and will coordinate cross-functionally with the development, permitting, and land team to ensure the constraints reflect the latest updates. They will work on 5-10 projects concurrently, in various stages of development. The successful candidate will review preliminary layouts and capacity analyses performed by the junior engineers, providing feedback and mentoring. The role requires significant cross-functional internal and external coordination. This position will report to the Director, Development Engineering.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Constraints Development

  • Create and take ownership of project CAD constraints, updating throughout the development cycle with inputs from cross-functional teams such as Land Acquisition, Permitting, Optimization, and Development.
  • Kick off and manage engineering related studies with consultants (hydro, geotech, topo, grading/drainage design)
  • Work with HV engineering team for substation placement and gen tie constraints
  • Help support utility crossing agreements by developing or reviewing MV and road crossing designs.
  • Be the overall technical leader on the project constraints, flagging items of concern to the development, permitting, and land teams as necessary.

Siting

  • Support in reviewing potential sites and assisting in pros/cons, impactful conditions (slopes, land features, soiling, structural), and other land considerations to help prioritize broader team to our most competitive sites.
  • Consider site/county/regional differences allowing for realistic guidance on land purchasing/leasing from site to site
  • Assess and filter site considerations quicker/more accurately (i.e. can eliminate ‘deal breaker’ conditions earlier) to help allow team to assess things faster and more efficiently
  • Review junior engineers’ early stage layouts to help assess how land feature may reduce buildable land and/or change the project size, production, or land required.

Coordination with project engineering

  • Ensure engineering project info is documented and organized on sharepoint
  • Verify completeness of site constraints and ensure they are ready to be provided for EPC RFP
  • Provide project support during the EPC design phase
  • Collaborate with project engineers on potential value engineering opportunities (grading, pile design, electrical design, etc..) during EPC design phase.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS in STEM field, Civil Engineering preferred
  • Commercially-minded engineer who can dive into details, but can see how design considerations impact bigger picture (doesn’t lose the forest in the trees)
  • 4+ years prior engineering experience in the utility scale solar industry
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD
  • Knowledge of PVCase or PVFarm or other modeling tools preferred, but not required
  • Ability to truly evaluate new technology – layout and design considerations to modules, trackers, storage, land use, etc.

description:

Avantus develops, owns and operates utility-scale clean energy projects across California and the Desert Southwest. ABOUT THE POSITION

We are seeking a highly motivated and organized candidate for the Sr. Associate, Project Finance position. The successful candidate will demonstrate sound industry knowledge, superior communications, and detail-oriented organizational skills.

The Sr. Associate would support a team of Project Finance professionals who source, negotiate, and execute project sales and structured financings, including whole or partial cash equity sales, construction financing, back leverage debt, and tax equity financing. The position requires an individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment, constantly collaborating with various internal and external teams to meet project and transaction deadlines. The individual would ultimately be responsible for supporting day-to-day execution of these transactions and performing analysis on the market and investors to develop project-specific valuations and economic sensitivities.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Valuation and Modeling:

  • Able to work independently and collaboratively with a cross-functional team.
  • Own every aspect of the project financial model for both mid-stage and late-stage development assets, including significant time working on project offtake bidding and structuring.
  • Monitor the debt, tax equity, and cash equity markets for appropriate valuation techniques and pricing
  • Prepare and explain capital structure sensitivities, becoming intimately familiar with the potential capital permutations and value levers
  • Understand the various development, construction, and operational inputs to the model, working closely with cross-functional experts in various functional groups such as Origination, Land Acquisition, Development, Construction, Engineering/Optimization, Storage, Interconnection, etc.

Transaction Support:

  • Support (and eventually lead) various aspects of a project sale and financing, including but not limited to:
  • Due Diligence
  • Process Timelines
  • Data room Management
  • Term Sheet and Transaction Document Support
  • Market/Transmission Reports
  • Appraisal and Cost Segregation Reports
  • Insurance Consultant Reports
  • Project Closing activities
  • Support Project Finance lead on marketing of project capital structure to outside parties, interacting with lenders, tax equity investors, infrastructure funds, and strategic buyers
  • Preparation and delivery of materials for Investment Committee and Risk Committee review and approval

Transaction Monitoring:

  • Support projects that are in construction or operational and financed by Avantus, including construction loan draws, refinancing activities, consent processes, financing document compliance, and modeling
  • Apply learnings from closed financial transactions and Avantus’ operational project portfolio to revise financial underwriting assumptions for development asset modeling and pricing

Marketing Analysis:

  • Macroeconomic analysis, including impacts of tax law change, interest rate environments, and broader sector trends
  • Monitoring of the power markets, including structured energy transactions, to help ensure project finance ability and valuation

Cross-Functional Support and Collaboration:

  • Support other functional areas in ways such as:
    • PPA Pricing and Finance ability analysis
    • Design/Engineering Optimization
    • EPC and O&M Contract Negotiations
    • Corporate FP&A Rollup analysis
    • Lease vs. Buy analysis

Other Responsibilities:

  • Support transaction team in various approval stage-gate and committee review processes
  • Manage various tracker and tool updates and dissemination, as needed

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in project finance, corporate finance, or investment banking, with direct exposure to renewable energy or infrastructure transactions
  • Demonstrated experience independently building, maintaining, and auditing complex project finance models, including full capital structure sensitivities (debt sizing, tax equity structuring, cash equity returns)
  • Strong working knowledge of project finance structures, including tax equity monetization (partnership flip, sale-leaseback), construction financing, and back-leverage debt
  • Proficiency in discounted cash flow analysis across pre-tax, after-tax, unlevered, and levered return frameworks, with ability to explain value drivers to non-technical stakeholders
  • Track record of engaging directly with external capital providers (lenders, tax equity investors, infrastructure funds, or strategic buyers) in a deal execution capacity
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent transaction workstreams (due diligence, data room management, closing activities) under tight deadlines
  • Advanced Excel modeling skills required; VBA or similar automation experience a plus
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience preparing materials for Investment Committee or Risk Committee review
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

NICE TO HAVES

  • Investment banking experience, particularly in renewable energy, infrastructure, or project finance coverage
  • Experience creating marketing materials (teasers, CIMs) and managing data rooms for live transactions
  • Experience with power markets, PPA structuring, or transmission/interconnection analysis

title: Sr. Director or Vice President, Digital Infrastructure
description:
ABOUT AVANTUS

Avantus develops, owns and operates utility-scale clean energy projects across California and the Desert Southwest. Our development pipeline of solar with integrated storage will generate enough dispatchable power to serve more than 10 million Americans, day and night. Backed by strategic investment from KKR and EIG, and building on more than a decade of industry leadership, Avantus is growing its position as an independent power producer, delivering affordable, reliable clean energy solutions to meet America’s growing energy demand.

ABOUT THE POSITION

The Sr. Director or Vice President, Digital Infrastructure leads Avantus' development of powered land and data center-oriented energy infrastructure. Energy availability, not capital, is now the binding constraint on data center growth, and “powered land” - entitled sites with a secured path to power - commands a structural premium. Avantus already controls large contiguous desert-southwest sites, generation interconnection queue positions, and utility relationships in exactly the geographies where hyperscalers are power- and land-constrained. This role stands up and leads Avantus' data center development unit, building a repeatable pipeline of powered land, co-development, and energy infrastructure opportunities, and translating the company's existing land and interconnection assets as well as developing new projects into a new, durable line of business. This role reports directly to the Chief Development Officer.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and lead Avantus' data center development function, converting the company's land and interconnection queue positions while developing new sites into a repeatable pipeline of powered land, co-development, and energy infrastructure opportunities.
  • Lead a small and nimble team responsible for end-to-end management of data center development projects, including site selection, design, permitting, and utility coordination; assess site feasibility based on Avantus’s generation resources, power availability, connectivity, environmental considerations, and regulatory requirements; and negotiate energy supply agreements including pricing, contract terms, and service levels to secure reliable, cost-effective power for data center operations.
  • Develop and execute integrated energy strategies for powered land, spanning greenfield monetization, co-development partnerships with data center operators, and selective self-development of energized campuses.
  • Source and structure opportunities across the full range of deal types - land monetization, JV-style co-development, project acquisitions, and M&A-adjacent structures - with developers, landowners, and infrastructure partners.
  • Coordinate with internal interconnection and transmission teams on load service requests, electrical service agreements, and transmission capacity with utilities and ISO/RTO operators.
  • Coordinate with internal real estate team to identify sites to lease or purchase to support facilities
  • Coordinate with internal environmental permitting team to manage county and state permitting processes
  • Partner directly with data center customers to deliver energy solutions through PPAs and on-site, off-site, or behind-the-meter technologies.
  • Evaluate prospective opportunities in partnership with internal power, engineering, development, finance, and commercial leadership, and help determine which should be funded, acquired, partnered, developed internally, or deprioritized.
  • Build and manage strategic relationships with utilities, hyperscalers, and infrastructure partners to structure innovative, repeatable energy solutions.
  • Represent Avantus with credibility and commercial judgment in confidential, market-facing conversations with developers, landowners, and data center operators.
  • Bring a data center and digital infrastructure lens to a team with deep power and renewable energy development experience, operating with the strategic judgment and hands-on execution a growth-stage platform requires.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • 12+ years of experience in energy management, utility-scale renewable development, or data center power infrastructure, including senior business development or project origination experience in digital infrastructure or adjacent power markets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or Construction Management; Master’s degree/MBA preferred.
  • Strong technical understanding of transmission infrastructure, grid interconnection processes, , and solar PV/BESS technologies, together with meaningful understanding of the data center ecosystem - how power, land, development readiness, and infrastructure constraints shape project viability.
  • Familiarity with FERC, NERC, and ISO/RTO market structures (e.g., ERCOT, WECC), and experience sourcing opportunities in markets where power availability and data center demand are creating new infrastructure needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to source opportunities directly through relationship-building, market outreach, and creative deal identification, with experience evaluating early-stage partnerships, JVs, or M&A-adjacent structures.
  • 5+ years of team leadership experience, with demonstrated success building a new function or line of business in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, high ownership, and comfort operating with ambiguity; strong communication skills and the maturity to represent a confidential growth platform externally.

description:
ABOUT AVANTUS

Avantus develops, owns and operates utility-scale clean energy projects across California and the Desert Southwest. Our development pipeline of solar with integrated storage will generate enough dispatchable power to serve more than 10 million Americans, day and night. Backed by strategic investment from KKR and EIG, and building on more than a decade of industry leadership, Avantus is growing its position as an independent power producer, delivering affordable, reliable clean energy solutions to meet America’s growing energy demand.

ABOUT THE POSITION

We are seeking a highly motivative and organized candidate for the Principal Engineer, HV Engineering. The successful candidate will demonstrate sound industry knowledge, superior communications, and detail-oriented organizational skills. This role reports to our Vice President, Design & Cost Engineering.

The Senior or Principal Engineer, HV Engineering serves as the technical authority for high-voltage infrastructure supporting utility-scale solar, energy storage, and hybrid energy projects. This role provides technical leadership for substations, switchyards, generation tie lines, interconnection facilities, owner-furnished high-voltage equipment, telecommunications systems, utility coordination, and project execution activities from early development through construction, commissioning, and operations.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide technical leadership for high-voltage engineering activities, including design basis development, shared infrastructure strategies, and review and approval of engineering deliverables through all project phases for facilities up to 500kV.
  • Establish and maintain design standards and long-term infrastructure strategies for shared high-voltage facilities supporting multi-phase developments.
  • Act as the Owner's technical representative and primary technical interface with utilities, EPC contractors, engineering consultants, Owner's Engineers, equipment vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Support utility interconnection requirements, RFIs, technical reviews, power system studies, and utility approvals throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead routing, siting, and design activities for transmission lines, generation tie lines, and interconnection facilities.
  • Manage and coordinate Owner's Engineers, engineering firms, specialty consultants, and design contractors.
  • Provide technical oversight of owner-furnished HV equipment including transformers, breakers, reactors, protection and control systems.
  • Support telecommunications, SCADA, protection, control, and communications architecture coordination.
  • Support HV estimating, cost engineering, value engineering, and cost optimization initiatives.
  • Review project schedules, engineering deliverables, procurement strategies, equipment delivery plans, and execution plans.
  • Identify and mitigate technical, schedule, procurement, cost, constructability, utility, execution, and operational risks.
  • Drive collaboration across Optimization, Development, Land, Permitting, Legal, Procurement, Construction, Asset Management, Operations Technology, EPC contractors, utilities, and consultants.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related engineering discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in HV engineering, substations, transmission systems, or utility-scale renewable energy projects.
  • Extensive experience with substations, switchyards, transmission lines, generation tie lines, and utility interconnections up to 500kV.
  • Experience supporting utility-scale solar, BESS, hybrid energy, or large-scale power infrastructure projects.
  • Experience managing owner-furnished HV equipment including transformers, breakers, reactors, and protection systems.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple engineering firms, Owner's Engineers, EPC contractors, utilities, equipment vendors, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of IEEE, NESC, NFPA, IEC, utility standards, and interconnection requirements.
  • Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • Advanced degree
  • Experience with CAISO, PG&E, SCE, NV Energy, or other utility interconnection processes.
  • Experience supporting telecom, SCADA, protection and controls.
  • Experience supporting construction, commissioning, and energization activities.

The role involves comprehensive management development of utility-scale solar photovoltaic projects through project management, economic analysis, document negotiation, and transaction support across a pipeline of projects targeting California (CAISO) and Desert Southwest wholesale power markets.  The successful candidate will have 7-12 years of experience in the energy industry, specifically in energy infrastructure development; strong financial analysis skills; an ability to effectively communicate complex ideas; and a proven track record to drive projects forward. 

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Greenfield development of utility-scale solar power generation facilities.
  • Engage community, local and state institutions for project support.
  • Assist in the preparation of permit applications for new and acquired solar facilities across multiple local, state, and federal jurisdictions. Managing contractors, vendors, and consultants to maintain project timeline and budget.
  • Negotiate tax abatements, land use agreements, mitigation settlements, and various other agreements.
  • Negotiate PPA’s with utilities and other energy buyers/offtakers.
  • Work with the finance department during financial feasibility analysis, evaluation and finance.
  • Assist with permitting and environmental compliance throughout the construction and operation of projects.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Extensive knowledge of the full-cycle of utility-scale renewable power generation development and marketing.
  • Extensive knowledge of interconnection, permitting, real estate, state/federal regulation, utility procurement goals, politics, law and other issues that impact development of renewable energy projects in the eastern energy markets.
  • Detailed understanding of the interconnection process (study process, contracting, utility requirements, financial obligations, and scope execution by utilities) to both site projects optimally and to advance them through COD.
  • Solid understanding of economic drivers within our business.
  • Concisely frame issues by providing context, analysis, recommendations and risk/benefit tradeoffs, both in written and verbal format, to project teams and to senior management. Create control and influence over the costs, terms, and schedules of key project milestones that are heavily dependent on external counterparties, often without strong commercial recourse.
  • Strong understanding of the relationships within a project schedule in order to prioritize teams’ resource allocation
  • Highly resourceful and able to design process for the advancement of project milestones and navigate through key risks where little structure is established.
  • Highly proficient in MS Excel (advanced proficiency required), Project, Word, and PowerPoint, as well as Google Earth
  • Independent self-starter who can meet deadlines and deliver quality products with minimal oversight.
  • Substantial ability to recognize opportunities, identify and evaluate risks in a development context as well as effectively communicate the foregoing.
